statement: There is no record of any grain shipment leaving Ostia for Alexandria in the spring of the year 212.

scope.who: the shipowner named in the register
scope.what: one grain shipment, Ostia to Alexandria

falsification_conditions: every supporting source traces back to a single origin
the harbour register entry postdates the voyage by more than a generation
the shipowner named is attested only in sources with a stake in the shipment
allowed_scope: what the surviving harbour register and the letters record. Nothing about how typical such voyages were, and nothing about anyone's intentions.
